name: Malaysia prohibited, restricted and danger areas
nameZh: 马来西亚禁区、限制区和危险区

layers.label: Prohibited area (P)
layers.summary: Prohibited area (ENR 5.1): flight of aircraft is not permitted at any time.

layers.label: Restricted area (R)
layers.summary: Restricted area (ENR 5.1): flight is allowed only if the published conditions are met. Read the times and conditions.

layers.label: Danger area (D)
layers.summary: Danger area (ENR 5.1): activities dangerous to aircraft may exist at the published times. Caution; check the conditions.

source.authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia (CAAM), AIP Malaysia ENR 5.1
source.extraction: scripts/airspace/my-enr51.mjs (parses the published tabulation; see exceptions.json for what was not converted)
